verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party data export or dump capability in open formats for leaving PlanetScale. Backups are created and restored within PlanetScale, and the import tool only moves data in. SQL shell access and `pscale sql` are building blocks a user could adapt into a manual export, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
